info.name: Geeknito LMS API
info.description:
Production-quality Postman Collection for the Geeknito Enterprise LMS backend. This collection supports dynamic variable synchronization for JWT authentication across Admin, Teacher, and Student roles, and contains complete test scripts and realistic request bodies matching the database seeder.

### Collection Variables Used
- `{{baseUrl}}` (defaults to http://localhost:8080 or the dev server URL)
- `{{jwtToken}}` (currently active authentication token, set automatically upon logging in)
- `{{adminToken}}` (automatically cached admin token)
- `{{teacherToken}}` (automatically cached teacher token)
- `{{studentToken}}` (automatically cached student token)

item.name: Authentication
item.description:
Folder containing Authentication and registration APIs. Logging in as any of the roles will automatically update the collection's active `{{jwtToken}}` and cache that specific role's token.

Geeknito LMS uses stateless JWT authentication. Logout is performed entirely on the client by removing the stored JWT token. No backend logout endpoint exists.

item.name: Certificates
item.description: Folder containing certificate generation trigger endpoints.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Geeknito LMS renders certificates entirely on the client-side using responsive HTML/Canvas. This endpoint is called by the frontend viewer to fetch the submission details (obtainedMarks, passingMarks, enableCertificates, student's fullName, and course details) to verify certificate eligibility and render details on the certificate template. If eligible, a unique certificate is rendered.

**Required Role:** Authenticated student / Teacher

**Authentication:** JWT Student Bearer Token (Bearer {{studentToken}})

**Expected Response:** Submission object details with passing details.

**Purpose:** Initiates the download compilation of the certificate. The frontend reads the submission data from this endpoint and packages it into a PDF vector download. This request represents the API backing that download trigger.

**Required Role:** Enrolled student

**Authentication:** JWT Student Bearer Token (Bearer {{studentToken}})

**Purpose:** Export the details of students assigned to a batch as an Excel Sheet. Note: select 'Send and Download' in Postman to save.
